title: The ESG-Innovation Disconnect: Evidence from Green Patenting
authors: Lauren H. Cohen; Umit G. Gurun; Quoc H. Nguyen
eligible_reason: No DiD or event-study design: the regressors of interest are time-invariant sector indicators (yenergy = energy industry, ytop = top-3 green sectors) and green-patenting ratios, estimated in pooled cross-sections with year FE only (areg/reghdfe a(year)), patent-level OLS/Poisson, and industry-year regressions. No treatment switches on over time.
design_notes: Tables 1-2 descriptives; Table 3 industry green-patent ratio on yenergy with year FE; Table 4 firm ESG score on green patents x yenergy/ytop with controls and year FE; Table 5 patent citations on yenergy (OLS/Poisson); Tables 7-8 patent-level thicket/first-mover; Tables 10-11 CDP/job-posting outcomes on green_patenting by sector. The full-text hit on 'difference-in-differences' is not reflected in any shipped regression.
data_provenance_note: README states all data needed are included (_data_1.dta to _data_11.dta, ~11 GB; includes extracts from licensed ESG, Compustat/CRSP, LinkUp, Trucost, CDP data).
screener_notes: Package title matches DOI per Crossref. Not a DiD paper. Screened from package only.
